profile.headline: Programmer
profile.summary:
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Well-rounded individual has 9 years experience working with computer software and hardware.

Specialties: apache webserver,  c,  c + +,  communication skills,  computer hardware,  email,  gateway,  hard drives,  inventory management,  laptop computers,  linux,  machinery,  microsoft c #,  microsoft excel,  microsoft windows xp,  networking,  office equipment,  operating systems,  perl,  printers,  sales,  shell scripting,  solaris,  ssl,  telephone skills,  troubleshooting,  unique,  unix,  linux, mysql, php, python, ruby

positions.title: Frontend Web Developer
positions.description:
Leveraged Github commands to provide source and versioning control, and get user requirements
Designed, developed, tested and documented react.js and JavaScript source in code base of 10000 lines
Enhanced as a team REST API back-end server code base written in JavaScript and node.js

positions.title: Programmer
positions.description:
Reverse Engineered Web Service written in C#, and parallelized for faster performance, 20% better service
Enhanced ASP.NET webpage, connected external Java Service, added concurrent IP search, saved 50% time
Created portable multi-threaded C# application which found lowest priced carpet meeting combinational criteria
Designed Quarry Manager website using C# .NET MVC, CSS, ASP.NET, T-SQL, HTML and JavaScript
Supported complex queries using inner joins, outer joins and associated table management within multiple databases
Enhanced over 20 SQL stored procedures, jobs using SQL Server 2008/2012, 10% more stable systems
Created over 10 Python applications which provided test data for C# applications and SQL stored procedures
Engineered web application which processed customer orders using jQuery, PHP5, and Ajax
Invented C++ Vulkan initializer using XML, Boost, Allocators, Google Test, and Python

positions.title: Computer Technician
positions.description:
Diagnose and troubleshoot, repair software in Windows and Mac OS 10.6.x environments for up to 5 computers daily
Disassembled complex hardware, installed parts, reassembled correctly, restored to working order, saved over $1000
Remove viruses and optimize equipment, document procedures according to company specifications

positions.title: IT Contractor
positions.description:
Implemented, configured applications in both Mac OS Tiger and Debian Squeeze environments, 30% results increase
Learned Moodle and Wordpress learning tool applications on the fly in order to understand needs of client
Reverse Engineered 1000 lines of code and configured Apache 2.2, PHP 5.2, and MySQL 5.1, saved over 100 hours

positions.title: Technical Support Specialist
positions.description:
Solved over 150 tickets regarding various Lotus Domino and Lotus Notes issues
Configured Ironport Appliances to block spam outbreaks that affected over 100 users
Modified Sendmail to route email on several TCP/IP ports in addition to standard port
Wrote script automating process of checking TLS given domains, shared with team
Helped over 20 clients access secure emails using Voltage SecureMail as encryption
Led initiative and implemented sudoers file on behalf of team for 7 different AIX servers 
Built functioning Sendmail configuration on Red Hat server behind multiple firewalls

positions.title: PRN Contractor
positions.description:
Followed detailed instructions regarding performing independent work successfully.
Imaged, inventoried, and installed new Windows 7 PCs at local Home Depot store.
Identified networking equipment and phone rack placement for Tolt Services Group.
Set up new printer on network, and sent old computer equipment to Tolt Services Group.

positions.title: Computer Technician
positions.description:
Implemented new email and web server, saved company over $3000 in software costs.
Traveled to over 60 different locations up to 80 mile radius to repair office equipment.
Solved over 1000 PCs and laptops with operating system, network, and hardware problems.
Troubleshot electromechanical problems regarding over 200 Inkjet and Laserjet printers.
Installed new server for school, saved school over $2500 in operating system costs.

positions.title: Inventory Clerk
positions.description:
Maintained inventory, quoted prices to customers, and helped customers on sales floor.
Installed additional 40GB hard drive into manager's new Windows XP computer system.
Registered over $100 of parts daily using Windows XP computer software.
Scheduled over 5 customers daily for service using Windows XP computer software.

positions.title: Senior Associate Applications
positions.description:
Discovered inefficiency in Unix script, rewrote in C, resulted 95% faster performance.
Enhanced C program implementing XModem protocol, uploads went 50% faster.
Supported and developed over 10 Perl programs in Solaris Unix environment.
Developed over 20 automated test cases in Aegis regarding over 5 Perl programs.
